simple.meaning: a Hagrite or member of a certain Arabian clan
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הַגְרִי (H1905) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr.

simple.summary: הַגְרִי (Hagrîy) means a Hagrite or member of a certain Arabian clan First listed occurrence: 1Chr 5 10.

definitions.short: a Hagrite or member of a certain Arabian clan
definitions.full: H1905. Hagri הַגְרִי 1. proper name, of a people only plural הַגְרִים Psa 83:7 ; הַהַגְרִאִים 1Chr 5:10 , הַהַגְרִיאִים 5:19-20 , a tribe (Aramaean ? Arabian ?) with which the east Jordan Israelites waged successful war; see dubious conjecture as to identity in Glas Skizze ii. 407. 2. adjective, of a people of an officer of David הַהַגְרִי יָזִיז 1Chr 27:31 . 3. proper name, masculine father of one of David's warriors בֶּןהַֿגְרִי 1Chr 11:38 (but || 2Sam 23:36 הַגָּדִי בָּנִי so here Öttli, compare Be Th Sm Dr Sm ). הַגְרִאִים הַגְרִיאִים, see foregoing. הֵד see below הדד . below הדד (perhaps make a loud noise ; so Arabic (of a falling building, rain, the sea, a braying camel); crash (of a falling wall, etc.), thunder ).
definitions.rootNote: or (prolonged) הַגְרִיא xlit Hagrîʼ corrected to Hagrîyʼ ; perhaps patronymically from 1904 ;
